Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may suspend up to 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, none of their Digimon can unsuspend until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers suspend, or effects trash cards from under your Tamers, trash your opponent's top security card.
